title: Houston Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern History Tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb:
Uncover the architectural marvel of the Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern on a guided walking tour. This fascinating underground space, originally built in 1926, served as Houston's drinking water reservoir and now boasts an impressive size of 1.5 football fields. Wander through the cavernous interiors, with its monolithic concrete columns, and experience the unique 17-second echo that delights visitors. Perfect for ages 9 and up, this tour combines history and fun as you learn about Houston's water system and the secrets of this iconic landmark.

- Guided walking tour of the historic Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern
- Unique subterranean architecture with a size comparable to 1.5 football fields
- Experience the fun of a 17-second echo in this vast space
- Learn about the history and significance of Houston's water reservoir
